pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding positions into a falling or rising knife; any subsequent order in the same direction requires a verified 15-pip momentum confirmation and independent risk bounds.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero-entry during high-impact ATR expansion candles; require institutional order block alignment and volume profile point-of-control (POC) rejection before market execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stop activation at +$4.00 and force partial scale-out once +$10.00 floating profit is achieved to lock in the asymmetric target range of $15-$30+.
